responsibility: This file implements GCC's runtime internationalization support helpers. It initializes libintl and locale settings, selects translated diagnostic quotation marks, records locale encoding and UTF-8 status, computes display widths of translated strings for aligned output, provides a fallback ngettext when NLS is disabled, and builds indentation strings based on translated text width. It is the support layer that lets diagnostics and other messages be localized while preserving formatting.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/intl.h, which defines the translation macros and declarations used throughout GCC, this .cc file provides the runtime state and helper implementations for locale initialization, quote selection, translated-width calculation, and fallback plural handling.
